The method comprises the following steps that recombinant agrobacterium tumefaciens containing a CsMYB60 gene editing carrier is adopted to convert Yutao 156, the CsMYB60 gene can be edited, after the CsMYB60 gene is edited through CRISPR/Cas9 endonuclease, the CsMYB60 gene mutation can be caused, and when the CsMYB60 genes of two homologous chromosomes are mutated, the activity of the protein CsMYB60 can be lost; the activity of the protein CsMYB60 is lost, so that white cucumbers with thorns are formed. The amino acid sequence of the protein CsMYB60 is as shown in SEQ ID NO: 3. Therefore, the cucumber with white fruit thorns can be obtained by editing the CsMYB60 gene of the cucumber. The method has an important application value.(ZH) 本发明公开了一种定点突变创制白色果刺黄瓜种质的方法。该方法包括如下步骤：采用含有CsMYB60基因编辑载体的重组农杆菌转化玉甜156，能够对CsMYB60基因进行编辑，CsMYB60基因通过CRISPR/Cas9核酸内切酶编辑之后，可造成CsMYB60基因突变，当两条同源染色体的CsMYB60基因均发生突变时，可以导致蛋白质CsMYB60活性丧失；蛋白质CsMYB60活性丧失形成白色果刺黄瓜。蛋白质CsMYB60的氨基酸序列如SEQ ID NO:3所示。由此可见，对黄瓜的CsMYB60基因编辑，可以获得白色果刺黄瓜。本发明具有重要的应用价值。",,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,39.9438284,116.2870162,,,,,Bei Jing Shi,China,Cucumber,,False,2023.0,,False,Other Genetic Improvement for Crop Traits

View less classifications",Chen Gongyou陈功友Xu Zhengyin徐正银Wang Sai王赛Liu Longyu刘龙宇Ma Wenxiu马文秀Liu Linlin刘琳琳Zou Lifang邹丽芳,上海科盛知识产权代理有限公司 31225,(EN) Method for cultivating broad-spectrum anti-bacterial-blight oryza sativa Indica by modifying OsSWEET gene promoters of oryza sativa Indica(ZH) 修饰水稻OsSWEET基因启动子培育广谱抗白叶枯病水稻的方法,"(EN) The invention relates to a method for cultivating broad-spectrum anti-bacterial-blight oryza sativa Indica by modifying OsSWEET gene promoters of oryza sativa Indica. Nucleotide sequences TACTGTACACCACCAAAAGT, ATATAAAAGCACCACAACTC and CCTCCAACCAGGTGCTAAGC are simultaneously constructed into a CRISPR/Cas9 system, with the assistance of an agrobacterium-mediated transgene system, genes OsSWEET11, OsSWEET13 and OsSWEET14 are subjected to site-directed mutagenesis in rice Huazhan, the oryza sativa material MS134HZ in which the OsSWEET11, OsSWEET13 and OsSWEET14 gene promoters are mutated simultaneously is obtained, and the oryza sativa material has a broad spectrum and is resistant to rice bacterial blight. The EBEs of the promoters of the susceptible genes OsSWEET11, OsSWEET13 and OsSWEET14 of MS134HZ are simultaneously modified, the capacity of resisting the bacterial blight is improved, and the spectrum is broader. In practical application, through the hybridization of mutant MS134HZ plants and other oryza sativa varieties, disease-resistant strains are bred.(ZH) 本发明涉及修饰水稻OsSWEET基因启动子培育广谱抗白叶枯病水稻的方法。将核苷酸序列TACTGTACACCACCAAAAGT、ATATAAAAGCACCACAACTC和CCTCCAACCAGGTGCTAAGC同时构建于CRISPR/Cas9系统中，借助农杆菌介导的转基因体系，在水稻华占中定点突变OsSWEET11、OsSWEET13和OsSWEET14基因，获得了OsSWEET11、OsSWEET13和OsSWEET14基因启动子同时突变的水稻材料MS134HZ，广谱抗水稻白叶枯病。MS134HZ的感病基因OsSWEET11、OsSWEET13和OsSWEET14启动子EBE同时被修饰，抗白叶枯病能力提高且更广谱。在实际应用中可通过突变的MS134HZ植株与其它水稻品种杂交，培育抗病品系。",,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,31.0252201,121.4337784,,,,,Shang Hai Shi,China,Rice,601.0,True,2019.0,2021.0,False,Disease Resistance

View less classifications",Yang Jie杨杰Wang Fangquan王芳权,南京苏高专利商标事务所(普通合伙) 32204,(EN) Applications of ALS (acetolactate synthase) mutant type protein based on gene editing technology and ALS mutant type protein gene in plant breeding(ZH) 基于基因编辑技术的ALS突变型蛋白及其基因在植物育种中的应用,"(EN) The invention discloses a rice ALS (acetolactate synthase) mutant type protein, a mutant type gene and applications of the rice ALS mutant type protein and the mutant type gene. The amino acid sequence of the ALS mutant type protein has following mutation: the 628-poisiton amino acid corresponding to the amino acid sequence of rice ALS has the mutation. The invention further discloses a breeding method of creating herbicide-resistant rice by gene editing. The CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing technology is used for editing the ALS gene for the first time, a T-DNA-knockout new material with the stably inherited herbicide resistant characteristic can be obtained in the T2 generation through offspring screening, and basic agronomic traits of the new material have no obvious change. Compared with breeding based on chemical mutagenesis, hybrid transform breeding and the like, the orderly improved molecular breeding technology based on gene editing has the advantages of being rapid, accurate, efficient and the like, and by means of combination with gene function marked genotype selection, breeding efficiency can be greatly increased and breeding progress is substantially accelerated.(ZH) 本发明公开了水稻ALS突变型蛋白、突变型基因及其应用，所述ALS突变型蛋白的氨基酸序列存在以下突变：其对应于水稻ALS的氨基酸序列的第628位氨基酸发生突变，本发明还公开了利用基因编辑创制抗除草剂水稻的育种方法。本发明首次利用CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑技术，对ALS基因进行编辑，通过后代的筛选，在T2代就可以获得剔除T‑DNA、抗除草剂特性稳定遗传的新材料，而新材料的基本农艺性状无明显改变。相对于化学诱变、杂交转育等育种，基因编辑定向改良分子育种技术具有快速、精准、高效等优点，结合基因功能标记基因型选择，将会极大提高育种效率，大大加快育种进程。",,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,32.035361,118.869025,,,,Nanjing,Jiangsu,China,Rice,,False,2018.0,,False,Pesticide Resistance

According to the invention, a corn fertility gene ZmbHLH51 is edited by using a CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing technology, and then a homozygous male sterile mutant without Cas9 transgenosis is obtained in an F2 generation through hybridization and selfing, so that a stable corn bhlh51 male sterile line is created. OsDPW2 gene is knocked out, changed or inhibited by using the conventional genetic engineering method or on the basis of a CRISPR/Cas9 system, and the expression level of the OsDPW2 gene is reduced in japonica rice background wild type rice, so that a rice male sterility line is obtained. View less classifications",,Shi Hua时华Wang Mo王莫Luo Qiong罗琼,福州元创专利商标代理有限公司 35100福州元创专利商标代理有限公司 35100,(EN) Application of rice broad-spectrum resistance regulation related gene OsRLCK107(ZH) 水稻广谱抗性调控相关基因OsRLCK107的应用,"(EN) The invention provides an application of a gene OsRLCK107 related to rice broad-spectrum resistance regulation and control. The length of an open reading frame of the rice broad-spectrum resistance regulation related gene OsRLCK107 is 1125bp, and the rice broad-spectrum resistance regulation related gene OsRLCK107 is used for coding cytoplasmic receptor-like kinase (RLCK) and consists of 374 amino acids. According to the invention, an overexpression vector OE-OsRLCK107 of the OsRLCK107 is constructed, so that the expression quantity of the OsRLCK107 gene can be obviously improved after the OsRLCK107 gene is transformed into rice. The result of a magnaporthe oryzae inoculation experiment shows that the resistance of an OsRLCK107 gene overexpression plant to magnaporthe oryzae is obviously enhanced. Besides, the rice gene OsRLCK107 is knocked out by adopting a CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing method, and compared with a wild plant, the knockout mutant has the advantages that the resistance to magnaporthe oryzae and bacterial blight is obviously weakened, and the main agronomic traits of the knockout mutant are not obviously changed compared with the wild plant. According to the invention, the function of the OsRLCK107 gene in improving the broad-spectrum resistance of rice is defined, and the gene has important application value in rice disease-resistant breeding and can be used for breeding or cultivating rice disease-resistant related varieties.(ZH) 本发明提供了一种水稻广谱抗性调控相关基因OsRLCK107的应用。所述水稻广谱抗性调控相关基因OsRLCK107的开放阅读框长1125bp，其编码胞质型类受体激酶（Receptor‑like cytoplasmic kinase，RLCK），由374个氨基酸组成。本发明通过构建OsRLCK107的过量表达载体OE‑OsRLCK107，转化水稻后能显著提高OsRLCK107基因的表达量。稻瘟菌接种实验结果显示OsRLCK107基因过量表达植株对稻瘟菌的抗性明显增强。另外，采用CRISPR/Cas9基因编辑的方法对水稻基因OsRLCK107进行敲除，敲除突变体与野生型植株相比，对稻瘟菌和白叶枯菌的抗性明显减弱，而敲除突变体在主要农艺性状上与野生型植株没有明显改变。本发明明确了OsRLCK107基因在提高水稻广谱抗性上的功能，显示该基因在水稻抗病育种上具有重要应用价值，可用于选育或培育水稻抗病相关品种。",,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,,25.124795,102.742834,,,,Kun Ming Shi,Yun Nan Sheng,China,Rice,,False,2023.0,,False,Disease Resistance
